{{nymph|parent=[[Arctura, Queen of the Arctic Ocean]]}}
Kolymus is the frost river god of the Kolyma River, a major river in northeastern Siberia, Russia. He is honored as the god of the frozen waters, revered for his role in the harsh and unforgiving landscapes of the Arctic region. Kolymus is often depicted as a formidable and resilient deity, associated with the icy and pristine waters of the Kolyma River that flow through the remote and rugged terrains of Siberia.
